pinyin_policy.dictionary_heads: Match cited reading for 43 located headwords; neutral syllables unmarked.
pinyin_policy.sentences: Word-oriented spelling; weekday expressions joined. Underlying third-tone marks retained; spoken realization depends on prosodic grouping, not an instruction to change every adjacent third tone. 一/不 surface variants shown for the taught examples: 一个 yí ge, 不是 bú shì; calendar/serial 一 yī. Neutral syllables unmarked; lexical gè may be ge in these phrases. Human phonetic review still required.
pinyin_policy.limitations: Character/NFC/tone-mark checks do not establish phonetic accuracy or naturalness; human Chinese review required.
